answer.reason: The verses tell what Bildad did: he came with his two friends to mourn with Job, answered Job in speeches, and offered sacrifice at the LORD's command.

clauses.english: came with two friends to mourn with Job and comfort him
clauses.quote: they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him

clauses.english: answered Job, asking whether God perverts judgment
clauses.quote: Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?

clauses.english: went and did as the LORD commanded, and was spared with his friends because Job prayed
clauses.quote: went, and did according as the LORD commanded them

doubts: The third clause cites verses 42:7-8 as context; the marked verse 42:9 only says he went and obeyed, so the sparing is drawn from the context verses.
